sn35.129:1.1: Ekaṃ samayam āyasmā Ānando Kosambiyaṃ viharati Ghositārāme || || 2
sn35.129:1.2: Atha kho Ghosito gahapati yenāyasmā Ānando tenupasaṅkami || pe || || 3 Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho Ghosito gahapati āyasmantam Ānandam etad avoca || ||
sn35.129:1.4: kittāvatā nu kho bhante dhātunānattaṃ vuttam Bhagavatāti || || 4
sn35.129:1.5: Saṃvijjati kho gahapati cakkhudhāturūpā ca manāpā cakkhuviññāṇaṃ ca sukhavedaniyam
sn35.129:1.7: Saṃvijjati kho gahapati cakkhudhāturūpā ca amanāpā cakkhuviññāṇaṃ ca dukkhavedaniyam
sn35.129:1.9: Saṃvijjati kho gahapati cakkhudhāturūpā ca upekhāṭṭhāniyā cakkhuviññāṇaṃ ca adukkhamasukhavedaniyam
sn35.129:1.11: Saṃvijjati kho gahapati sotadhātu || || 6 Saṃvijjati kho gahapati ghānadhātu || || 7 Saṃvijjati kho gahapati jivhādhāturasā ca manāpā jivhāviññāṇaṃ ca sukhavedaniyam
sn35.129:1.13: Saṃvijjati kho gahapati jivhādhāturasā ca amanāpā jivhāviññāṇaṃ ca dukkhavedaniyam
sn35.129:1.15: Saṃvijjati kho gahapati jivhādhāturasā ca upekhāṭṭhāniyā jivhāviññāṇaṃ ca adukkhamasukhavedaniyam
sn35.129:1.16: phassam paṭicca uppajjati adukkhamasukhā vedanā || || 8 Kāyadhātu || || 9
sn35.129:1.19: manodhātudhammā ca amanāpā manoviññāṇam ca dukkhavedaniyam
sn35.129:1.21: Saṃvijjati kho gahapati manodhātudhammā ca amanāpā manoviññāṇaṃ ca dukkhavedaniyam phassam paṭicca uppajjati dukkhā vedanā || || Saṃvijjati kho gahapati manodhātudhammā ca upekhāṭṭhāniyā manoviññāṇañca adukkhamasukhavedaniyam
sn35.129:1.23: Ettāvatā kho gahapati dhātunānattaṃ vuttam Bhagavatāti || || 1
